sqlite_wal_reset.upstream_fact: SQLite upstream documents a rare WAL-reset corruption race for versions 3.7.0 through 3.51.2 and a fix in 3.51.3; the trigger requires WAL plus multiple database connections in separate threads/processes and a tight write/checkpoint race.
sqlite_wal_reset.decision: KEEP_F_V01_13_FAIL_CLOSED; package version alone cannot prove FIXED or VULNERABLE because downstream backports are possible and current upstream source-id mapping is non-canonical.

claycode_semantic_conflict.hypothesis: PR #310's Compare evaluator accidentally folds the Boolean result of one relation into the next relation, so a grammar-legal comparison chain can diverge from adjacent-pair comparison semantics.
claycode_semantic_conflict.strongest_counterhypothesis: The ClayCode surface may intentionally define comparison chains as a Boolean left-fold; the current syntax comment says chains are evaluated left-to-right, and no owner-fixed semantic contract found in this cycle disambiguates the phrase.
claycode_semantic_conflict.observed_implementation: Compare evaluation assigns left = apply_relation(left,right) on every step; after the first relation, left is Bool. Python bool is a subclass of int, so numeric ordering accepts that Bool unless explicitly excluded.

minimal_discriminator.promotion_rule: Do not call this a confirmed evaluator bug until the comparison-chain semantic authority is fixed or recovered; treat it now as an OPEN_SEMANTIC_CONFLICT and mandatory regression/test obligation.

claycode_semantic_conflict.secondary_type_boundary: Even outside chains, runtime ordering currently uses isinstance(x,(int,float)); in Python this accepts Bool. If ClayCode Bool and numeric types are nominally distinct, true < false is a type-boundary leak and must fail closed.

out_of_box_experiment.name: RELATIONAL_CHAIN_METAMORPHIC_MUTATION_MATRIX
out_of_box_experiment.method: Enumerate integer triples a,b,c in [-3,3] and all ordered pairs of six relation operators (<,<=,>,>=,==,!=). Compare the current PR #310 Boolean-left-fold algorithm against adjacent-pair chain semantics.
out_of_box_experiment.boundary: This quantifies consequence if adjacent-pair semantics is authoritative; it does not itself decide the language semantics and is not target-VPS evidence.

analysis.baseline_scope: PR #310's 200576-case differential baseline is strong evidence for decide_effect only; it does not cover generic relational-chain semantics. PR #314 demonstrates this exact class of risk by finding two unrelated silent semantic/lexical defects that the decide_effect corpus did not exercise.
analysis.integration_risk: PRs #313 and #314 are sibling stacks on #310 while #312 declares a #310 dependency from a main-based branch. No combined commit-head status check was observed for the composed stack in this cycle. Individual green receipts must not be promoted as composition evidence.
analysis.storage_result: PR #311's SIGKILL oracle is useful process-crash evidence but does not target the upstream WAL-reset race and cannot resolve the Ubuntu backport question.

required_next_actions: Recover or owner-fix explicit comparison-chain semantics before evaluator promotion.
Add a comparison-chain differential/metamorphic regression gate covering true/false outcomes and mixed relation operators.
If Bool and numeric are nominally distinct, explicitly reject Bool in numeric ordering instead of relying on Python isinstance(int).
Create and target-test a composed integration head containing #310 + compatible #313/#314 semantics plus #312 before current-work PASS credit.
Resolve SQLite fix presence by exact patched-source/package provenance or a target-specific trigger-unreachability proof; keep F-V01-13 fail closed meanwhile.
architecture_delta.rollback: No target runtime or product state changed in this research cycle; drop this candidate if an owner-fixed ClayCode contract explicitly defines Boolean left-fold comparison chains and dedicated tests confirm that semantics.

negative_or_unknown_results: Ubuntu package version 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 alone did not establish whether the upstream WAL-reset fix is backported.
